item.title: TT-104: Undo
item.brief: Implement only TT-104 from BACKLOG.md in tasktracker.store.TaskStore. Follow every acceptance criterion exactly: undo most recent not-yet-undone add/complete/delete in LIFO order; restore/remove/change task as specified, preserving id and exact deleted task; ids never reused after undo add; define NothingToUndo and raise when history exhausted; failed operations are not recorded. Add focused tests. Keep existing suite passing. Use only Python standard library. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` and commit this ticket as its own commit, without including other ticket changes.

pr.body: Implemented a private operation history in tasktracker/store.py and NothingToUndo for exhausted history. Delete undo restores the exact Task object; completion undo restores the status from before that operation, including repeated completion; add undo removes the task without decrementing the ID counter. Added focused coverage in tests/test_basic.py for mixed LIFO behavior, exhausted history, failed operations, monotonic IDs, and repeated completion. Full unittest suite passes (8 tests); git diff --check passes. No external dependencies; only Python standard library used.
pr.summary: Added LIFO undo for task add, completion, and deletion. Before: successful mutations could not be reverted; now: undo restores task state and identity, while added IDs remain consumed.
pr.title: Implement TaskStore undo

risk.why: Contained behavior change to TaskStore with focused tests; the initial review found and prompted correction of repeated-completion status restoration. The final delta review passed with no findings, and the full suite passes.

item.title: TT-101: Reject impossible due dates
item.brief: Implement only TT-101 from BACKLOG.md in tasktracker.dates. Follow every acceptance criterion exactly: define InvalidDate(ValueError); all unsupported or impossible date text raises it and the message contains original input; accept today/tomorrow case-insensitively with surrounding whitespace; +Nd means N nonnegative days after today, rejecting negative and unsigned offsets. Add focused tests. Keep the existing suite passing. Use only Python standard library. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .` and commit this ticket as its own commit, without including other ticket changes.
